course_description: Camille is training for a half marathon in six weeks. Runs, strength work and stretching feed the week's goal and the charts; weight, sleep and mood tell how the body keeps up. Demo: what you add here goes at the next update.
work_description: Camille is a freelance designer. The stopwatch counts the hours per client, the tasks carry their due dates, the notebook tells the projects; a rush week shows in the Running zone too. Demo: what you add here goes at the next update.
kitchen_description: Each meal points to a food card; a variable draws the day's calories from them, which a chart sets against the target. The shopping list and the recipes live beside them. Demo: what you add here goes at the next update.
balcony_description: Tomatoes, basil and chillies: the plants' cards, the harvests pointing to them, the watering and feeding reminders, and what was done. Demo: what you add here goes at the next update.
italian_description: An Italian evening every night before the trip to Rome: a questionnaire, the week's goal counting it, useful phrases and the suitcase. Demo: what you add here goes at the next update.
runs_description: Each run, in km, with its duration, type and feeling. The goal "Training week" counts the runs and adds up the week's km; the chart "Km per week" and the variable km_semaine_demo read them too.
strength_description: A strength session took place: that is all an occurrence records, with the exercises as free text.
stretching_description: Yes or no, every evening: a yes/no tracking, filled with a touch on its tile.
weight_description: The morning weigh-ins, in kg. The variable poids_moyen_7j_demo averages them over 7 days, which the chart "Weight and average" draws beside them.
sleep_description: Each night's length, with its quality. The week's goal asks for 7 h on average; the chart "Sleep and mood" sets it against the mood.
mood_description: One mark a day, from 1 to 5, in no group. Two charts read it: "Sleep and mood" and "Mood calendar".
course_goal_no_pain_instructions: Tick at the end of the week if no pain hinders running.
course_goal_description: One attempt a week, Monday to Sunday: at least 3 runs, the week's km above objectif_km_demo, 7 h of sleep on average, and "No pain" ticked by hand. Changing the variable changes the goal.
chart_km_description: Each week's km, read from Runs step by step: the build-up to the half marathon, and the dip of the rush week.
chart_weight_description: The weigh-ins of Weight as points, and the variable poids_moyen_7j_demo day by day as a line: a chart can read entries and variables together.
chart_sleep_mood_description: Two views one above the other, sleep then mood, over the same days: the short nights of the rush week show in the mood.
chart_mood_calendar_description: Each day's mood as a colour, a column per week and a row per weekday.
course_notebook_description: Each week's review, written by the automation "Weekly review" from the runs, the sleep and the goal.
foods_description: One card per food, with its calories, protein and carbs per 100 g. Each meal points to a card; the variable kcal_jour_demo reads the calories there.
meals_description: Each food eaten, filed by moment of the day, with its quantity and a reference to its card in Foods.
water_description: A glass of water, a touch: a counter, one entry per glass.
chart_kcal_description: Each day's calories, worked out by kcal_jour_demo, as bars that turn red above objectif_calorique_demo, drawn dashed.
shopping_description: What the pantry lacks. The automation "Weekly menu" adds what the planned meals need.
recipes_description: Free notes, in the order given to them: the recipes that come back.
hours_description: Each work session, timed, named by its client, with its project and whether it is billed. A shortcut per client starts the stopwatch; heures_semaine_demo adds them up since Monday.
tasks_description: What is left to do, some tasks with a due date: notified when it comes, a late task waits to be checked, and the dot says so on the tile.
invoicing_content: Go over last week's billable hours and send the invoices.
invoicing_description: A message every Monday at 9: a regular stream, each send of which stays readable here.
work_notebook_description: The projects told week after week, the rush week included.
chart_hours_description: Each week's hours, a colour per client, read from Hours by the entry's name.
plants_description: One card per plant on the balcony. Each harvest points to its own.
harvests_description: Each picking, in grams, with a reference to its plant.
observations_description: What one notices in passing, in a few words: a text tracking.
fed_description: The fact of having fed the plants, nothing more: what the message "Feed the tomatoes" asks, noted once done.
watering_content: Tomatoes and basil first, at the foot, without wetting the leaves.
watering_description: A reminder on Monday, Wednesday, Friday and Sunday at 7 pm.
feeding_content: One dose of liquid feed in the watering can, then note it in "Fed".
feeding_description: A reminder on the 1st of each month. What was done goes into "Fed".
balcony_todo_description: What is to be done once, before a moment: a list with due dates.
balcony_notebook_description: The season told: sowing, first flowers, pests.
chart_harvests_description: The grams picked each week since the first tomatoes.
evening_description: Three questions every evening at 8 pm: an invitation waits until it is filled, alone or with the AI. The goal "Italian week" counts the evenings filled and the words learnt.
italian_goal_description: One attempt a week: 5 evenings filled and at least 40 words learnt, read from "Italian evening".
phrases_description: Notes to read again on the train: at the restaurant, at the station, at the hotel.
suitcase_description: What to take, checked as it goes in.
chart_words_description: The words learnt each week, read from the evenings filled.
plant_tomato_watering: Every other day, at the foot
plant_strawberry_watering: In the evening, fruit kept dry
task_accountant: Send the statements to the accountant
btodo_aphids: Treat the aphids on the mint
recipe_porridge: Pre-run porridge: 60 g of oats, 200 ml of milk, a mashed banana, a spoon of honey. Five minutes on a low heat, eaten two hours before the long run.
recipe_lentils: Lentil bowl: red lentils, carrots, cumin, coconut milk. Twenty minutes, and it lasts two days.
recipe_salmon: Baked salmon, sweet potato and courgettes: 200 °C, twenty-five minutes, a drizzle of olive oil and lemon.
recipe_pesto: Balcony pesto: two handfuls of basil, 30 g of parmesan, almonds instead of pine nuts, olive oil.
recipe_chickpeas: Roasted chickpeas: drained, dried, smoked paprika, twenty minutes in the oven. The rush week's snack.
recipe_skyr: Skyr with berries and honey, to recover after intervals.
phrase_table: At the restaurant — Un tavolo per due, per favore. (A table for two, please.)
phrase_bill: At the restaurant — Il conto, per favore. (The bill, please.)
phrase_platform: At the station — Da quale binario parte il treno per Roma? (Which platform does the train to Rome leave from?)
phrase_ticket: At the station — Un biglietto di andata e ritorno. (A return ticket.)
phrase_checkin: At the hotel — Ho una prenotazione a nome di Camille. (I have a booking under the name Camille.)
phrase_run: Running — Dove posso correre qui vicino? (Where can I run nearby?)
phrase_way: In the street — Scusi, come arrivo al Colosseo? (Excuse me, how do I get to the Colosseum?)
phrase_coffee: At the bar — Un caffè e un cornetto, grazie. (A coffee and a croissant, thank you.)
wnote_brume_kickoff: First meeting with Studio Brume: a whole identity for their new dance studio. They want something light, almost blurred. Good leads.
wnote_rameau_site: The bookshop wants a new website before the holidays. Small budget, but a loyal client for three years.
wnote_brume_logo: Studio Brume approved the logo on the second proposal. The guidelines and the autumn posters remain.
wnote_mairie_call: The town hall wants the festival posters in ten days. It is tight, but it is the job of the year. I said yes.
wnote_rush_1: Third evening finishing after 11 pm. Skipped intervals, sleep is not keeping up. Must hold on until Friday.
wnote_rush_2: Posters sent to the printer at 5 pm. The town hall is delighted. I am drained: a weekend without screens.
wnote_after_rush: Review: 50 hours in a week is too much. From now on, two days of margin on any short-deadline quote.
wnote_rameau_late: The Le Rameau website invoice is still unpaid. I'll chase them on Monday.
wnote_brume_posters: Studio Brume's autumn posters are out. They are already talking about a second season.
bnote_sowing: Cherry tomatoes and basil sown in pots, on the window sill.
bnote_outside: The seedlings go outside. The strawberry already has its first flowers.
bnote_first_tomato: First red tomato! Eaten on the spot, of course.
bnote_neglect: Rush week, the balcony suffered: the mint's leaves are drooping. A big watering.
bnote_aphids: Aphids on the mint. Diluted black soap, to do again in a week.
bnote_harvest: Over 300 g of cherry tomatoes this week. Pesto planned with the basil.
course_review: %1$s runs for %2$s km, %3$s of sleep on average. %4$s
course_review_good: A good week: keep heading for the half marathon.
course_review_rush: The rush week took over: short nights and a single run. Easing back in.
strength_exercises_b: Squats 4 × 10, calf raises 3 × 20, side plank 3 × 45 s
evening_phrase_7: A che ora chiude il museo?
auto_review_seed: Review the training week that just ended. Read the Runs (count, km, kinds), the Sleep (average), the Mood and last week's attempt of "Training week". Write an entry in the "Training notebook", titled "Week of" followed by the Monday's date: the week's km, the number of runs, the average sleep, and one sentence of advice for the coming week, with the half marathon a few weeks away in mind. Change nothing else.
auto_menu_seed: Suggest the coming week's meals, suited to the training: more starch the day before Sunday's long run, protein after intervals. Start from the Foods cards and the last two weeks of Meals. Add to "Shopping" what these meals need, with no duplicate of an item already there and unchecked. End with the menu in a few lines.
auto_morning_seed: Go over the working day: the late Tasks and those due today, and this week's Hours per client, the running stopwatch included. Change nothing. Answer in a few lines, then ask me with a communication module what I start with, offering the two most urgent tasks.
intervals_description: The Thursday session: 8 × 1 min fast, 1 min 30 easy between. The timer passes each step, a beep counts down the last 3 seconds, the voice says what comes. The figures go to Runs.
intervals_run_instruction: 5 km pace, steady to the end
intervals_cooldown_instruction: Easy jog then stretches; « Done » when finished
